locally_available_herbs.name: St John's Wort
locally_available_herbs.use: mood — FLAG: interacts with contraceptives, antidepressants, blood thinners

where_to_source: Reformhaus (health food stores), DM and Rossmann drugstores (large herbal sections), weekly farmer markets (Wochenmarkt), REWE/Edeka/Lidl for basic herbs and teas, online (iHerb.de, Amazon.de for supplements)
dietary_norms: No major religious food taboos for most. Vegetarian and vegan options widely available. Halal meat available in major cities. Pork is the most consumed meat historically. High-quality whole-grain bread culture. Bio (organic) certification widely trusted and common.

herb_warnings.st_johns_wort: Interacts with: contraceptives (reduces efficacy significantly), antidepressants (serotonin syndrome), HIV medications, blood thinners, immunosuppressants. ALWAYS flag before recommending.
